# Cornetta

> Cornetta is a free, open-source call recorder for Mac (macOS 14.4 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel), with a beta version for Windows 10 and 11. It records your voice from the microphone and the other people from system audio into one .m4a file, with any calling app: WhatsApp, FaceTime, Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Slack, Discord, Telegram, browser calls. No account, no audio driver, no subscription. Made by Federico Nejrotti. Interface in Italian. Source code: https://github.com/stellakamikaze/cornetta (MIT license).

Key facts:
- Price: free. No account, no ads. Open source under the MIT license.
- Privacy: recordings and transcripts never leave the computer. The website counts visits with cookieless Plausible on the developer's own server. The app sends anonymous usage data (app version, OS version, architecture, recording/transcription outcome, error code, duration range, random installation id); never audio, text, file names, device names or contacts. It can be turned off from the app menu ("Invia dati di funzionamento"). Details: https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/en/privacy/
- How it works: Core Audio process taps (macOS 14.2+) capture system audio; the microphone and the tap share one private aggregate device, so both voices stay in sync. No BlackHole or virtual driver.
- Output: .m4a (AAC, 48 kHz, stereo) in ~/Music/Cornetta, file named "Chiamata YYYY-MM-DD HH.MM.m4a".
- Your voice is levelled up to +24 dB to match the call; the boost pauses while the other person talks so speaker echo is not amplified.
- Local transcription (macOS 26+): when a recording ends, Cornetta transcribes it on the Mac with Apple speech recognition (SpeechAnalyzer), labels lines as "Tu" (you) or "Altri" (others) from the separate tracks, removes speaker echo, and saves a Markdown file next to the audio. Recordings window with search and playback from any timestamp.
- Detects when an app starts using the microphone and offers to record; suggests stopping when the call ends.
- Floating panel while recording: elapsed time, level meters for you and the others, Stop, Feedback.
- Automatic updates (Sparkle, EdDSA-signed) with a visible in-app notice.
- First launch: the app is not from the App Store, so macOS asks to confirm it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. Two permissions: Microphone and System Audio Recording.
- Windows (beta): Windows 10 and 11, per-user installer without administrator rights, automatic updates (Velopack). Records the microphone and the output assigned to communications (the devices Teams, Zoom and WhatsApp use) into one .m4a file, and detects calls from active microphone audio sessions. Transcription is Mac-only for now. Download: https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/download/windows
- Not available on iPhone or Android: iOS gives no app access to call audio, Android blocks it for regular apps since Android 10.
- Legal (Italy): recording a conversation you take part in is lawful for personal use; sharing it without consent is not. Other countries differ.

## Pages
- [Cornetta (Italiano)](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/): home page, features, install guide, FAQ
- [Cornetta (English)](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/en/): same content in English
- [Privacy (English)](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/en/privacy/): what stays on the computer, visit statistics, app usage data
- [Privacy (Italiano)](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/privacy/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/stellakamikaze/cornetta): Swift (Mac), C# (Windows), Cloudflare Worker (site and services)

## Downloads
- [Download for Mac](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/download): latest signed disk image
- [Download for Windows (beta)](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/download/windows): per-user installer
- Homebrew (Mac): `brew install --cask stellakamikaze/tap/cornetta` (tap: https://github.com/stellakamikaze/homebrew-tap)
- [Latest version info](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/downloads/latest.json): version, size, SHA-256
- [Update feed](https://cornetta.stellakamikaze.org/appcast.xml): Sparkle appcast with release notes
